searchText: Yeah, I mean, for SSZ transactions, this scheme would allow embedding the signed transaction as is, without converting. While the current EIP-6404 approach performs conversions on all transactions, even SSZ ones PartialContainer should be simple as well, if not even simpler, as implementations already know how to serialize containers. Will give it a shot though in remerkleable. The serialization of this scheme is actually equivalent to the union, except it has a bitmask at the start instead of a type number. For merkleization, the scheme ensures that common fields are colocated regardless of type number. Meaning, consuming merkle proofs no longer requires a giant switch statement to cover the various tree shapes, which is good for simple ZK schemes as well
